body.text:
For over 2,000 years, Persian wrestlers trained in the Zurkhaneh ("house of strength") with a simple wooden board.

They called it the Shena. It means "swimming," because that's what the push-up looks like when it's done right: smooth, rhythmic, and powerful.

We make each one by hand, from start to finish, out of A+ grade African mahogany. You can have your name engraved on it too.

It's a small piece of ancient training for your living-room floor.
